text:
mina: Quick heads-up — Cassiopeia v1 onboard eval shows weird token boundary gaps for zh/ko and a bidi bracket flip for Hebrew/Arabic translations. BLEU down ~12% on a subset. :frowning_face:
liam: ugh. do you have a minimal repro or an eval diff? :eyes:
mina: throwing a couple examples here. short ones but consistent.

```
input (zh): 我们去了公园，孩子们玩得很开心。
gold (en): We went to the park; the kids had a great time.
pred (en): We went to the park the children had very fun.
```

mina: notice the missing punctuation -> tokenization seems to merge "孩子们 玩得" into awkward spans which shifts generation.
tao: can you run tokenization debug? maybe spm vs pretokenizer mismatch.
mina: ran local tokenize tool, difference between onboard tokenizer and our training tokenization: onboard uses pre-normalize NFKC + collapse-zws, training didn't. results: several zh punctuation tokens swallowed.
aisha: that normalization change would definitely change prefix cache hits. did you check kvcache alignment?
mina: yes, kvcache offsets mismatch in the profiler. small example where prefix length differs by 2 tokens -> generation drifts.
liam: any RTL issues example?
mina: hm here's one from he->en:

```
input (he): שלום (המשפט) — האם הכל בסדר?
gold (en): Hello (the sentence) — is everything ok?
pred (en): Hello )the sentence( — is everything ok?
```

mina: bracket order flipped — looks like bidi mirroring or a normalization that is reordering punctuation around parentheses.
tao: is this after quantization or on fp16 bring-up?
mina: observed on both fp16 and q5 inference builds, but worse on q5 (more token merges). fp16 still has punctuation re-order sometimes.
aisha: got logs from the eval runner? maybe the preprocessor step in the new infra strips U+200F/LTR marks. ops-bot: eval-runner-1389: completed cassiopeia-v1 multilingual sweep (2000 samples) — 295 failures flagged (regression threshold 5%).
liam: can you share the failing sample ids? we should diff tokenizer outputs for train vs onboard.
mina: uploaded diffs to the eval bucket (s3://rwd-evals/cassiopeia/v1/token-diffs/2956781234). quick sample id: cass-00042 shows merged token indices.
tao: suggestion: try reverting the early normalization step in the onboard tokenizer to match training, run small smoke with kvcache instrumentation. I can run a canary later today.
aisha: also add a small bidi unit test for bracket mirroring and a quick locale-specific BLEU per-language to catch this earlier.
liam: +1 on per-locale alerting. we should add a rule: any >2% delta on zh/ko/ he/ar triggers immediate triage.
mina: thanks. I'll start the bisect: first check normalization diff (NFKC vs none), then pretokenizer config, then kernel-level token merging in the quantized tokenizer.
ta0: FYI i'll set up the canary with q5 and fp16 variants and ping the channel when results done.
mina: cheers. tagging @tao @aisha. will post updates; leaning toward normalization mismatch as primary cause. :thumbsup:
